title: FulfillmentHistoryResponse
description: Paginated response containing fulfillment history entries

data.description: List of history entries ordered oldest-first

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page. Empty when no more pages exist.

FulfillmentHistoryEntry.description: A single state-change event in the fulfillment history ledger

created_at.description: Timestamp when the event was recorded

fulfilled_delta.description: Change in fulfilled quantity for this line item

packed_quantity_delta.description: Change in packed quantity for this line item

picked_quantity_delta.description: Change in picked quantity for this line item

product_id.description: The ID of the product associated with the line item

quantity_delta.description: Change in total quantity for this line item

sale_line_item_id.description: The ID of the sale line item this event relates to

source_sale_id.description: The ID of the source sale (present for RETURNED and SPLIT events)
